name: real_forecast_supervision_inventory_v1
limitations: An expert panel mean is a historical forecast, not an outcome or a verified true probability.
GDP contraction in a specified quarter is not an NBER recession or an FOMC/CPI contract.
A dated archive retrieved today is not an independently preserved original publication snapshot.
No exact individual forecast issue times or identical teacher information sets are asserted.
No source report or target probability may be passed as the student's forecasting evidence.
Multiple horizons and repeated forecasts for a GDP quarter are correlated; no random row split.
Source and benchmark overlap review, time-bounded student evidence, outcome semantics and evaluation cohort are required before forecast SFT.
